rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken term when the exact type of cooking vessel is not important or is clear from context.

example.english: This saucepan is the most convenient for cooking noodles.
example.traditional: 呢個煲用嚟煮麵最方便。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 bou1 jung6 lai4 zyu2 min6 zeoi3 fong1 bin6

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean a deep cooking pan with a long handle, rather than an ordinary pot.

example.english: When I make sauce, I use a long-handled saucepan because it is easier to stir.
example.traditional: 煮醬汁嗰陣，我會用長柄煲，方便啲攪拌。
example.jyutping: zyu2 zoeng3 zap1 go2 zan6 ngo5 wui5 jung6 coeng4 beng2 bou1 fong1 bin6 di1 gaau2 bun6
